ED_Title: High-level meeting on the midterm review of the New Urban Agenda
ED_DecisionText: At its 102nd plenary meeting, on 16 July, on the proposal of its President, decided to invite Nga Kor Ming, Minister of Housing and Local Government of Malaysia and President of the United Nations Habitat Assembly; Chimwemwe Chipungu, Minister of Lands, Housing and Urban Development of Malawi; Jan Szyszko, Secretary of State at the Ministry of Development Funds and Regional Policy of Poland; Anar Guliyev, Chairman of the State Committee on Urban Planning and Architecture of Azerbaijan; and Anacláudia Rossbach, Executive Director of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme to make statements in the opening segment of the high-level meeting on the midterm review of the New Urban Agenda.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
